encoding: strict UTF-8 JSON; no replacement characters or unpaired surrogates
source_identity: source_id is an opaque case-sensitive source key, preserved verbatim; duplicate keys are invalid

columns.source_id: Required ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen, 1–64 characters; never a canonical patient ID
columns.patient_source_id: null for patient; exact source patient key for appointment
columns.display_name: Synthetic-prefixed demonstration name for patient; null for appointment
columns.birth_date: Explicit ISO calendar date or null for patient; null for appointment
columns.phone: empty or +1555000 followed by four digits for patient; empty for appointment
columns.email: empty or example.test address for patient; normalized lower case in preview; empty for appointment
columns.starts_at: null for patient; explicit ISO timestamp with UTC offset for appointment
columns.state: null for patient; booked/cancelled/completed/no_show for appointment

target: synthetic_import_rows.preview_target only; canonical practice_patients/appointments are never written
identity_rule: Contact equality only creates duplicate_candidate review rows; it never merges identities or grants cross-practice access
reconciliation: Persist complete source manifest and server SHA-256 before processing. Resume by saved batch UUID/version/cursor. Finalize only after exactly expected_rows exist; report valid/invalid/review totals and exact source ordinals.
